name: cmdb_customview_attr
label: CMDB Custom View Attribute Table
description: The custom view attribute table in the CMDB is used for related query scenarios in configuration management, such as reporting.

fields.name: customview_id
fields.description: View ID, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: customview_ci_uuid
fields.description: The unique identifier of the model in the view. A standard index is defined on this field, making it suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

fields.name: uuid
fields.description: UUID, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: attr_id
fields.description: The attribute ID. A standard index is defined on this field, making it suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

indexes.name: PRIMARY
indexes.description: Primary key index covering the customview_id, UUID fields, suitable for uniquely identifying records and queries that join the primary table.

indexes.name: idx_attr_id
indexes.description: Standard index covering the attr_id field, suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

indexes.name: idx_customviewci_id
indexes.description: Standard index covering the customview_ci_uuid field, suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.
